description: This Java abstract class defines configuration properties for file-based device registry implementations within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes settings for file location, caching, persistence, and modification permissions.
external_files: NONE (no external files directly referenced, but typical external dependencies include java.lang, java.util)
external_methods: NONE (no external methods explicitly invoked outside the class)

classes.name: AbstractFileBasedRegistryConfigProperties
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for configuration properties of file-based device registry implementations in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify default filename for the registry storage.

methods.name: setCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache age in seconds; throws IllegalArgumentException if negative.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the configured maximum cache age in seconds.

methods.name: isSaveToFile
methods.description: Checks whether persistence to file is enabled.

methods.name: setSaveToFile
methods.description: Enables or disables persistence of registry data to the filesystem.

methods.name: isModificationEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if modifications such as create, update, delete are permitted.

methods.name: setModificationEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables modifications to the registry.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the path to the file where the registry is persisted.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename or path for persistence.

methods.name: isStartEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the registry should initialize empty on startup, ignoring existing data.

methods.name: setStartEmpty
methods.description: Configures the registry to start empty regardless of existing data.
